title: World Train Map Atlas: the world's legendary train routes
description:
The world's notable passenger train routes as open data, from World Train Map: one record per route with its termini, category, operator, rolling stock, length, top speed, published journey time, opening year, the countries it crosses in travel order, a one-line description and a renown rank, plus its line.

Two licences. The facts, data/routes.csv and data/routes.json, are CC BY 4.0: credit World Train Map. The route lines, data/routes.geojson, are derived from OpenStreetMap and are offered under the Open Database License 1.0, © OpenStreetMap contributors; the facts repeated in that file are offered under the ODbL there as well. The MCP server code in mcp/ is MIT. Zenodo allows one licence label per record, so this record is labelled ODbL, which covers the whole archive; the fact files inside it are also available under CC BY 4.0. See data/LICENSE.
